turns.text: Hi, um, yes, I need to change my, my flight. The booking code is LJ9X2A. Last name is Tanaka. Sorry, Tanaka.
Thanks. I have booking code LJ9X2A, but the last name doesn't match Tanaka exactly. Could you spell your last name for me, letter by letter?
Oh, okay. T, A, N, A... K, A. Tanaka. I think that's right?
Thank you. I still need the last name exactly as it appears on the booking. Could you spell it one more time?
Sorry, um. T-A-N-A-K-I. Tanaki. Yes, Tanaki, that's right. I'm sorry.
Thank you, I have your booking verified now. What would you like to change?
So I'm on the, the Sunday flight, the eleven fifty-five at night to London. I'd like to move to, to an earlier one if I can.
Your flight is SK214 from Dubai to London this Sunday at 23:55, on a Flex fare. On Flex there is no change fee, but you pay any fare difference. Which earlier flight did you have in mind?
Um, the eight-ten in the morning? SK210? Is there, is there still space on that one?
Yes, SK210 leaves Dubai at 08:10 on Sunday and has seats. It is $410 in Economy, compared with $380 for your current flight, so the fare difference would be about $30.
Thirty dollars? Okay. And the change itself is free because it's Flex, right? Sorry, I'm a little confused.
Yes, there is no change fee on Flex. Only the $30 fare difference applies. Shall I move you to SK210 on Sunday at 08:10?
Sunday, yes? Same day, not Monday?
Same day, Sunday. I would change LJ9X2A from SK214 at 23:55 to SK210 at 08:10, with a $30 fare difference. Say yes to confirm.
Done. Booking LJ9X2A is now on SK210, Dubai to London, Sunday at 08:10. Summary: moved from SK214 to SK210 on Sunday with a $30 fare difference. Anything else I can help with?
No, that's it. Thank you. Bye.
